correctness.rationale: The unital endomorphism is uniquely f(t); nonunits are exactly leading order d>=2 and form a composition ideal. Nonzero leading coefficients multiply without cancellation; all ranks on the maximal ideal follow by distinct leading degrees of image monomials. Rank finite differences recover Jordan blocks. Leading coefficient census gives each fiber, and geometric order distribution with exponentially small tail gives the depth limit. All 11 independent exhaustive prime-field cases passed. Zero substitution, N>=3 and field assumptions included.
